blueprint.title: VR Paper — GL Standard Style

sections.instructions: This section is about words. Read each question. Five answers are shown — pick the one that fits and mark it clearly. If a question feels hard, move on and come back at the end. A blank scores nothing, so a careful guess beats no answer.
This section is about letters hiding and moving. Work the same way as before: read, pick one of the five answers, mark it clearly. Keep a steady pace — about a minute for each question is plenty.
This section is about codes and numbers. Read each question, work it out on paper if that helps, and mark one answer. Check the clock when you finish a page — steady beats rushed.
